source: Held-out LDCT work-up notes; hand-authored, frozen in git before any reader was run; synthetic

reports.text: Lung health check clinic - diagnostic work-up after LDCT (Lung-RADS 4B). The patient did not attend her CT-guided biopsy appointment on the 12th and could not be reached by telephone. Letter sent. Rebooking pending.

Thoracic assessment clinic. Patient failed to attend today's consultation. Note: she attended the pre-assessment spirometry last week (normal), but no work-up of the nodule has taken place and no MDT discussion yet.
Outcome of invitation for PET/CT following abnormal screening LDCT: DNA x2. Referrer informed.
WORK-UP RESULT | attended: no (DNA) | biopsy: none | outcome: none.

Bronchoscopy with EBUS-TBNA performed today for a 16 mm right upper lobe nodule (Lung-RADS 4B). Samples sent to cytology. Result awaited. Case to be discussed at lung MDT once the result is available.
Respiratory clinic review after LDCT category 4A. PET/CT arranged but the patient declined the scan and any biopsy for now, wishes to think. No investigation was done. To return in 4 weeks.

PET/CT today: FDG-avid nodule SUVmax 7.4. A CT-guided core biopsy was taken; histology not yet reported. The previous screening round in 2025 was Lung-RADS 2, no relevance. Awaiting pathology before any decision.
Appointment for diagnostic CT thorax cancelled because the scanner was out of service; postponed to next week. No investigation performed. She attended for the booking.
MDT outcome not yet available: case not discussed at the lung MDT; biopsy not yet performed. No decision has been made about treatment or return to screening.

Lung MDT meeting list: patient listed for discussion next Thursday following biopsy on the 4th. Histology: malignant cells identified, pending immunohistochemistry typing; final report awaited. Plan: for discussion.
She attended. CT-guided biopsy done and the cytology preliminary report suggests possible carcinoma but the final report is not yet available. Lung MDT has not met. Outcome pending.
WORK-UP RESULT | attended yes | investigation: not done (patient unwell) | biopsy: none | outcome: pending.

Lung MDT outcome. Histology from CT-guided biopsy: adenocarcinoma. PET/CT: localised, no nodal disease. Discussed at the thoracic multidisciplinary meeting - recommendation: lobectomy. Referred to thoracic surgery.
Lung cancer MDT (discussed on the 9th). EBUS-TBNA cytology positive for non-small cell lung carcinoma. Stage IIIA. Plan: concurrent chemoradiotherapy. Referral to clinical oncology made today.

Attended thoracic clinic. Seen last year (2025) for a benign granuloma, which is unrelated. Current nodule: biopsy shows squamous cell carcinoma. MDT decision documented: stereotactic body radiotherapy (SABR) for an early-stage tumour. Referred to oncology.
Thoracic MDT: 4X lesion left upper lobe, core biopsy malignant (small cell carcinoma, limited stage). MDT recommends chemoradiotherapy; referral to medical oncology sent.
MDT OUTCOME | attended: yes | biopsy: adenocarcinoma (malignant) | discussed at lung MDT: yes | plan: surgery, referral to thoracic surgery done.
MDT note: previously (2024) a benign lesion was resected on the other side. This episode: biopsy of the right nodule is malignant, small cell. MDT decision: referral to oncology for systemic therapy.
Diagnostic work-up complete. PET/CT: low uptake. CT-guided biopsy: granulomatous inflammation, no malignancy. Discussed at lung MDT: benign. Patient to return to the annual lung screening programme.
Bronchoscopy and biopsy of right lower lobe lesion. Histology shows organising pneumonia; there was no evidence of malignancy or carcinoma. MDT: no further action; return to annual LDCT screening.

Lung MDT outcome (nodule 4A). The family history of cancer was noted but is not relevant to this decision. Tissue: benign hamartoma on biopsy, no malignant cells. Decision: back to the annual screening round.

Respiratory MDT discussion: after interval LDCT and PET showing no uptake, the lesion has resolved on imaging. No biopsy was required. MDT decision: benign inflammatory change; return to annual screening.
WORK-UP RESULT | attended yes | biopsy: benign | MDT: discussed - benign | outcome: return to annual LDCT.
Attended. Biopsy: non-diagnostic sample; repeat biopsy not needed after MDT review of PET (no uptake). MDT decision: benign; return to annual screening.
Respiratory clinic. PET/CT shows mild uptake (SUV 2.1) in the 9 mm nodule; biopsy not feasible given position, benign by MDT consensus. Plan: surveillance CT in 3 months.
Percutaneous biopsy: benign lung tissue, no malignancy. Lung MDT agreed to keep under surveillance. Interval CT in six months before any return to the screening programme.
Thoracic clinic review. Nodule assessed with diagnostic CT; the MDT recommended repeat CT in 3 months to confirm stability.
WORK-UP RESULT | attended yes | investigation: diagnostic CT done | tissue: none | outcome: repeat CT 3 months.
MDT summary: biopsy shows adenocarcinoma. Decision: return to annual screening with LDCT in 12 months.
Clinic note: referred to thoracic surgery for lobectomy. Biopsy: benign. No MDT mentioned.
Short letter: the patient attended the thoracic clinic today. Examination unremarkable. Thank you for your referral.
